description: Map the -1 and -2 glycone subsite lining residues of the 1E0V cellobiosyl complex onto Tlr1902 and test conservation against the global background
code:
import requests, numpy as np, collections, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L',
     'LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def fetch(p): return requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb",headers=H,timeout=120).text
def parse_all(txt, chain="A"):
    prot=collections.OrderedDict(); het=collections.OrderedDict()
    for l in txt.splitlines():
        if l[:6] not in ("ATOM  ","HETATM") or l[16] not in " A": continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip(); nm=l[12:16].strip()
        if l[76:78].strip()=="H": continue
        xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        key=(l[21],int(l[22:26]),l[26])
        if rn in AA3 and l[21]==chain: prot.setdefault(key,{"rn":rn,"at":{}})["at"][nm]=xyz
        elif rn!="HOH" and l[:6]=="HETATM": het.setdefault(key,{"rn":rn,"at":{}})["at"][nm]=xyz
    return {k:v for k,v in prot.items() if "CA" in v["at"]}, het
def seqof(p):
    ks=list(p); return "".join(AA3[p[k]["rn"]] for k in ks), ks
def fit(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); V,S,W=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    return V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W))])@W,pc,qc
def tf(X,R,pc,qc): return (np.atleast_2d(X)-pc)@R+qc
def dpal(A,B,cut,gap=-0.6):
    D=np.linalg.norm(A[:,None]-B[None],axis=2); S=1/(1+(D/3.)**2); S[D>cut]=-0.2
    n,m=D.shape; M=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); Pt=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=(M[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1],M[i-1,j]+gap,M[i,j-1]+gap); k=int(np.argmax(c)); M[i,j]=c[k]; Pt[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        k=Pt[i,j]
        if k==0:
            if D[i-1,j-1]<cut: pr.append((i-1,j-1))
            i-=1;j-=1
        elif k==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr[::-1]

refP,refH=parse_all(fetch("1E0V"),"A"); refS,refK=seqof(refP)
refCA=np.array([refP[k]["at"]["CA"] for k in refK])
G2F=[v for v in refH.values() if v["rn"]=="G2F"][0]; BGC=[v for v in refH.values() if v["rn"]=="BGC"][0]
meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q8DHP3",headers=H,timeout=90).json()[0]
qtxt=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],headers=H,timeout=120).text
qP,_=parse_all(qtxt,"A"); qS,qK=seqof(qP)
plddt={}
for l in qtxt.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("ATOM  ") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA": plddt[int(l[22:26])]=float(l[60:66])
ANCH=[("AENEMK",1,"HENALK",1),("RGHTLAWH",2,"RGHTLFWE",2),("RGHTLAWH",6,"RGHTLFWE",6),("WDVVNEA",5,"FDVNNEM",5),
      ("CYNDYNVE",3,"YVNDYGII",3),("VGFQSHF",5,"IGIQAHL",5),("AITELDIQ",3,"LKITEVSV",4),("TVWGVRD",2,"LLWGFWA",2),
      ("SDSWRSE",3,"GNHWRPQ",3)]
ai=[refS.find(a)+b for a,b,c,d in ANCH]; bi=[qS.find(c)+d for a,b,c,d in ANCH]
qCA=np.array([qP[k]["at"]["CA"] for k in qK])
R,pc,qc=fit(qCA[bi],refCA[ai])
for cut in (6.,4.5,4.0,3.5):
    pr=dpal(tf(qCA,R,pc,qc),refCA,cut); R,pc,qc=fit(qCA[[a for a,b in pr]],refCA[[b for a,b in pr]])
q2r=dict(pr); r2q={b:a for a,b in pr}

# residues of 1E0V lining the -1 (G2F) and -2 (BGC) sugars
lig={"-1":np.array(list(G2F["at"].values())),"-2":np.array(list(BGC["at"].values()))}
rowsout=[]
for i,k in enumerate(refK):
    X=np.array(list(refP[k]["at"].values()))
    d1=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-lig["-1"][None],axis=2).min()
    d2=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-lig["-2"][None],axis=2).min()
    if min(d1,d2)<4.0:
        j=r2q.get(i)
        qres = "%s%d"%(qS[j],qK[j][1]) if j is not None else "(unaligned)"
        pl   = plddt.get(qK[j][1],np.nan) if j is not None else np.nan
        rowsout.append({"subsite":"-1" if d1<=d2 else "-2","1E0V":"%s%d"%(refS[i],refK[i][1]),
                        "d(A)":round(float(min(d1,d2)),2),"Tlr1902":qres,
                        "identical":(j is not None and qS[j]==refS[i]),"pLDDT":round(float(pl),1) if pl==pl else None})
t=pd.DataFrame(rowsout).sort_values(["subsite","d(A)"])
pd.set_option("display.width",200)
print("Glycone subsite lining of S. lividans Xyn10A (1E0V, cellobiosyl-bound) mapped onto Tlr1902 by structural alignment")
print(t.to_string(index=False))
n=len(t); nid=int(t["identical"].sum())
print("\nidentity at glycone-subsite-lining positions: %d/%d = %.0f%%  (global Q8DHP3 vs 1E0V core identity 30.0%%)"%(nid,n,100*nid/n))
arom=t[t["1E0V"].str[0].isin(list("WYF"))]
print("aromatic platform positions: %d, of which conserved as aromatic in Tlr1902: %d"
      %(len(arom), int(sum(a[0] in "WYF" for a in arom["Tlr1902"] if a!="(unaligned)"))))
print("mean pLDDT over these positions: %.1f"%np.nanmean(t["pLDDT"].astype(float)))
from scipy import stats
print("\nbinomial test, subsite identity %d/%d vs background 0.300: p = %.4g"%(nid,n,stats.binomtest(nid,n,0.300,alternative='greater').pvalue))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.2))
sub=t.reset_index(drop=True)
cols=["#2b8a3e" if x else "#c92a2a" for x in sub["identical"]]
ax.bar(range(len(sub)),sub["pLDDT"].astype(float),color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(sub)))
ax.set_xticklabels(["%s\n%s"%(a,b) for a,b in zip(sub["1E0V"],sub["Tlr1902"])],fontsize=7,rotation=90)
ax.axhline(90,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(0.2,91,"pLDDT 90 (very high)",fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel("Tlr1902 model pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(50,100)
ax.set_xlabel("1E0V glycone subsite residue (top) and its Tlr1902 structural equivalent (bottom)")
ax.set_title("Tlr1902 glycone subsite: %d/%d positions identical to S. lividans Xyn10A (green), vs 30%% global core identity"%(nid,n),fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
